review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: There is an opinion that public museums and art galleries will play an essential role in the community no more due to the thrive and convenience of internet. However, I am of the opposite school of thought.

Admittedly, technology nowadays provide people a beneficial way to experience culture and historic by their own. Consisting of high-resolution images, three-dimensional reconstructions and virtual reality platforms, the internet and modern systems enable viewers to explore masterpieces or ancient artefacts in remarkable detail, without leaving home. This can be easily seen in the way some popular museums in the world offer viewers both online and offline experiences of their diverse artworks and historical items by using cutting edge technology for those people who cannot afford and have mobility issues, can still access a vast range of cultural and historical heritages.

However, I strongly believe that public museums and art galleries will still necessary for several reasons. Chief of them is; online experience, cannot replicate the direct sensory engagement of seeing an artefact or artwork in person, which can evokes emotions and a sense of authenticity that images cannot convey. A popular example is Viet Nam, a country renowned for it long and adorable history, which being saved and conveyed through countless generations by its cultural and historical heritages. Furthermore, these traditional services, is vital cultural hubs, it play and pivotal role in symbolizing the identity of a region. This is a magnet for tourism and a facilitator of bonding within the community.
In conclusion, I strongly convinced that despite the convenience and popular of the internet and modern technology, the role of cultural hubs like public museums or art galleries is undeniable.

completion.comment: Bài có mở bài, hai đoạn thân bài và kết bài đầy đủ.

review.overall: Em giữ lập trường phản đối và hai thân bài đúng chức năng; ý về Việt Nam là điểm riêng. Nhưng ví dụ này chưa cho thấy trải nghiệm trực tiếp đem lại điều gì khác hình ảnh trên mạng. Câu công nghệ kéo dài, gộp online/offline với người khó chi trả; các khung “will still necessary”, “can evokes” và “I strongly convinced” đều sai ở mức động từ nền đã học. Bài còn ẩu ở khâu tự soát. Em cần nghiêm túc, cầu thị viết lại từng câu được đánh dấu, thêm cơ chế cảm xúc cho ví dụ Việt Nam và kiểm toàn bộ động từ trước khi nộp.

paragraphs: There is an opinion that public museums and art galleries will become unnecessary as the growth and convenience of the internet enable people to see historical objects and works of art on a computer. However, I am of the opposite school of thought.

Admittedly, technology nowadays provides people with a beneficial way to experience culture and history on their own. task.text:
Some people claim that public museums and art galleries will be no longer needed because people can see historical objects and works of art by using a computer.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
